title: [29.x]Changing Negative Amount Format to Parentheses modifies displayed decimal precision despite unchanged rounding settings in the Financial Reports
summary: Financial Reports now preserve the configured decimal precision when displaying negative amounts in parentheses format instead of forcing a fixed two-decimal pattern.
key_points: Negative amount formatting no longer overrides the column's configured rounding settings
The fix formats amounts according to precision first, then applies parentheses for negative values
Decimal precision remains consistent whether showing negative amounts as minus signs or parentheses
Updates affected multiple localization test files to reflect corrected behavior
quote: Format the amount using the configured precision first, then wrap negative values in parentheses.
